warm buckwheat pancakes, crème fraîche, cured fish, roe and chives, passed round trackside

Warm little buckwheat blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, salmon roe and chives, passed round like trackside in Monaco. Whisk 100g buckwheat flour, 50g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 200ml milk into a thick batter. Drop teaspoons into a buttered frying pan over medium heat and cook 1 minute a side until golden, making about 24. Cool slightly. Top each with a little crème fraîche from 150g, a fold of smoked salmon from 200g, a few salmon roe and snipped chives.
Beef and pork dumplings boiled and tossed in butter and dill, with sour cream
Beef and pork dumplings boiled until they float, tossed in butter and dill, with sour cream.
M: Tony's wild birthday party at the Malibu house

Rare roast beef eye fillet sliced thin onto soft brioche buns with hot horseradish cream, rocket and crispy fried shallots. Season an 800g eye fillet, sear all over and roast at 220C for 18 minutes, then rest 15 minutes and slice thinly. Mix 150g sour cream with 2 tbsp horseradish, a squeeze of lemon and salt. Split and lightly toast 12 brioche slider buns. Spread with horseradish cream, layer on the beef and a handful of rocket, and finish with crispy fried shallots.
Miso honey glazed salmon over sushi rice with edamame, avocado and pickled ginger
Salmon fillets glazed with miso and honey, roasted at 200C for 12 minutes, over rice with edamame, avocado and pickled ginger.
W: Fried yeast doughnut rings with a simple icing glaze and sprinkles
Yeasted doughnuts fried at 175C until golden, dipped in a glaze of icing sugar and milk, some with sprinkles.
K: Vodka, blue curaçao and lime topped with lemonade, with a booze-free swap

Vodka and blue curaçao topped with lemonade and lime over crushed ice, glowing electric blue like the reactor in Tony's chest. Fill 4 tall glasses with crushed ice. Into each pour 30ml vodka, 20ml blue curaçao and 10ml fresh lime juice, then top with about 150ml chilled lemonade and stir gently. Garnish with a lime wheel. For a booze-free version, swap the vodka and curaçao for 20ml blue cordial and extra lime.

s.note: Sugared strawberries with lemon and a bowl of softly whipped cream for dipping
s.how: Hull and halve 2 punnets strawberries and toss with 1 tbsp caster sugar and a squeeze of lemon. Whip 300ml thickened cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar to soft peaks and serve in a bowl beside the berries for dipping.

s.note: Beef and pork dumplings boiled and tossed in butter and dill, with sour cream
s.how: Mix 250g beef mince and 250g pork mince with salt and pepper. Fill dumpling wrappers and pinch into little round parcels. Boil until they float, then a minute more. Toss in melted butter and chopped dill and serve with plenty of sour cream.

m.note: Miso honey glazed salmon over sushi rice with edamame, avocado and pickled ginger
m.how: Mix 2 tbsp white miso with 2 tbsp honey and brush over 4 salmon fillets. Roast at 200C for 12 minutes until glazed. Serve over cooked sushi rice with thawed edamame, sliced avocado and a little pickled ginger.

w.note: Fried yeast doughnut rings with a simple icing glaze and sprinkles
w.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast, 50g melted butter, 2 eggs and 250ml warm milk into a soft dough and prove an hour. Roll, cut into rings and prove again. Fry at 175C until golden. Dip in a glaze of icing sugar and milk and add sprinkles to some.
